OPERATION
  Set AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES from 10 to 60 in production payments.conf (PaymentsService).

WHY
  Production AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES=10 is below CAPTURE_DELAY_MINUTES=15, so authorization holds lapse before capture (E4021); restore the documented default of 60, which exceeds the capture delay as the schema requires.
  Claim: E4021 means the payment authorization hold lapsed before capture; it is not retryable.
    source lookup_error_code('E4021') (confidence high, coverage complete)
    the source returns: E4021: Payment authorization expired / Cause: The authorization hold lapsed before capture. / Handling: Re-authorize, then capture. Do not retry capture alone.
  Claim: The payments schema documents AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES with default 60 and the rule that it must exceed CAPTURE_DELAY_MINUTES (default 15) or holds lapse before capture.
    source get_config_schema('payments') (confidence high, coverage complete)
    the source returns: AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES integer False 60 Minutes the provider holds an authorization. Must exceed CAPTURE_DELAY_MINUTES or holds lapse before capture.
  Claim: Production payments has AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES=10 and CAPTURE_DELAY_MINUTES=15, so the hold is shorter than the capture delay.
    source read_config('production', 'payments') (confidence high, coverage complete)
    the source returns: AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES=10
  Claim: AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES also configures LedgerService (when uncaptured authorizations lapse and pending entries are reversed) and RenewalsWorker (how long renewal authorizations are held before capture).
    source trace_configuration('AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES') (confidence high, coverage complete)
    the source returns: LedgerService: It is configured by AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES, which it uses to decide when an uncaptured authorization has lapsed and its pending entry should be reversed. / RenewalsWorker: It is configured by AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES, which sets how long a renewal authorization is held before capture.

AFFECTS
  LedgerService: It is configured by AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES, which it uses to decide when an uncaptured authorization has lapsed and its pending entry should be reversed.
  RenewalsWorker: It is configured by AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES, which sets how long a renewal authorization is held before capture.
  7 affected within 4 hops:
  LedgerService via LedgerService -DEPENDS_ON-> PaymentsService
  OrderService via OrderService -CALLS-> PaymentsAPI (exposed by PaymentsService)
  RenewalsWorker via RenewalsWorker -CALLS-> PaymentsAPI (exposed by PaymentsService)
  BillingService via BillingService -DEPENDS_ON-> OrderService then OrderService -CALLS-> PaymentsAPI (exposed by PaymentsService)
  ReportingService via ReportingService -DEPENDS_ON-> OrderService then OrderService -CALLS-> PaymentsAPI (exposed by PaymentsService)
  SearchService via SearchService -DEPENDS_ON-> OrderService then OrderService -CALLS-> PaymentsAPI (exposed by PaymentsService)
  ApiGateway via ApiGateway -CALLS-> OrdersAPI (exposed by OrderService) then OrderService -CALLS-> PaymentsAPI (exposed by PaymentsService)
  Source: trace_configuration('AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES') (coverage complete)
  Source: find_dependents('PaymentsService', max_depth=4) (coverage complete)

REVERSIBLE
  The value: yes. Setting AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES back to 10 restores it.
  Requests handled while the new value is live: no.

ALTERNATIVES
  1. Apply to staging only and watch it before production.
  2. Do nothing: AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES stays 10 in production.
  3. Lower CAPTURE_DELAY_MINUTES below 10 instead; rejected because no documented value supports it and it leaves AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES far below its default.
  4. Retry captures; rejected because E4021 is not retryable and needs re-authorization.
